Name: Paper Mario Partners in Stardew Valley
Author: AnotherStardewValleySunday
Description:
This mod adds five partners from Paper Mario: The Thousand Year Door (more coming eventually!) to the Adventurer's guild. Each can be hired once per day, and will follow you until you go to bed or until you hire another one. They can be befriended, but do not have unique dialogue or heart events and cannot be romanced.

Goombella: 750g for the day. Press 'O' and she will describe the current map. If there is an NPC in front of you, she will tell you their name, birthday, and favorite items.

Koops: 750g for the day. Press 'O' to throw his shell in the direction you are facing. If you're holding a hoe or a watering can (with water in it), he will hoe or water the ground. If you are holding a pickaxe or an axe, he will attempt to use it on whatever he hits. He can also pick up certain dropped items for you. (Don't rely on this.)

Bobbery: 2000g for the day. Press 'O' and he will walk a few steps and then unleash the power of a mega bomb on the area around him. (I intend to nerf this... eventually.)

Vivian: 1500g for the day. Press 'O' and she will hide you in the shadows until you press 'O' again. In the shadows, you cannot attack or use a tool, or eat food. You can still open your inventory. (NOTE: Do not use cheats to warp around while hiding in the shadows, as this can cause you to get stuck in walls.)

Mini-Yoshi: 1000g for the day. Press 'O' to get on and off of him (Note: I am not adding a flutter jump). Includes all 7 variants, one of which is chosen at random whenever the game starts.

Ms. Mowz: 1000g for the day. Press 'O' and she will tell you about the foragables on the current map (which ones and how many), as well as how many artifact spots, gem nodes, iridium nodes, and gold nodes can be found. (Hopefully more useful than she is in the original game.)

COMING SOON:
Flurrie
A 'dismiss' hotkey
Soft integration with 'Fighting With NPCs'

INSTALLATION:
Unzip the file into your mods folder. If you have an older version installed (from when this mod was 2 folders), you need to delete both of them to install this version.

KNOWN BUGS:
-If you warp somewhere while hidden in the shadows, you may get stuck. Please refrain from warping until you have left the shadows.
-The first few times you use Vivian, Koops, Mini-Yoshi, Ms. Mowz or Bobbery after hiring them, they may play the wrong animation. This should go away on its own.
-Items may occasionally get stuck to Koops.
